title: Agniveer has arrived
text: A new hero has entered the Trinetra Universe. Aarav Rathore, the fiery guardian of Lucknow, now joins the growing roster as Agniveer.

title: Meet Agniveer — the blazing guardian of Lucknow
text: The official Agniveer character profile is now live, revealing Aarav Rathore, the Divine Trishul Core, Agni-Lok, his powers, weapons and weaknesses.

title: The official Trinetra Comics website is live

title: The Trinetra hero roster expands
text: Dedicated hero profiles are being developed as the Trinetra Universe grows beyond its first guardians.
